policies.title: German ordinary passports: named visa-free visitor routes
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly records visa-free short-visitor entry for the listed German ordinary-passport destinations.
conditions: VG: tourism up to 90 days, with an online entry and customs form before departure. XK: entry and stays up to 90 days. UA: up to 90 days in each 180-day period. TN: tourism, private or business stays up to 120 days. PA: up to 90 days. BA: up to 90 days in six months.
This records an ordinary German passport short-visitor baseline only; it excludes work, residence, study, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Palestinian Territories access via Israeli ETA
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office treats access to the Palestinian Territories through Israeli-controlled entry as requiring ETA-IL for otherwise visa-exempt German visitors.
conditions: An ETA-IL confirmation is required before entry to Israel and is checked by airlines before departure; ordinary German nationals need no visa for stays of up to three months.
This does not establish a Palestinian Authority visa, access to Gaza, permit requirements, checkpoint opening, Palestinian-ID-holder treatment or final admission.

application.label: Israeli Population and Immigration Authority ETA-IL
steps: Apply online before travel using the German ordinary passport to be used for entry.
Carry the approval and comply with Israeli carrier, checkpoint and final-admission rules.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly identifies a border-issued short-visitor route for each listed German ordinary-passport destination.
conditions: DJ: a visa can be applied for at entry. KM: tourist visa is issued on arrival at Grande Comore international airport. TM: airport issuance requires a pre-issued Turkmen Migration Service visa approval/invitation. CI: prior online application is followed by issuance at entry. GW: airport visa is available for 30 days; land-border issuance is unavailable. BD: normally available for tourism or business up to 30 days at Dhaka international airport, subject to listed documents. KH: tourist visa is available on arrival at all international border crossings.

TM and CI are classified as visa_on_arrival because the visa itself is issued at the border after pre-approval, not because of their online or pre-travel steps. This excludes special documents, work, residence and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named electronic visitor-visa routes
policies.summary: Official guidance identifies an electronic visa issued before travel for the listed German ordinary-passport visitor routes.
conditions: IQ: federal Iraq ended visa-on-arrival issuance on 1 March 2025 and requires an e-visa before entry; Kurdistan has a distinct e-visa process. CU: the Cuban official tourism portal describes the internet tourist visa replacing the tourist card. GA: the temporary e-visa procedure is only for tourists. GQ: for air entry, an online e-visa is required; land entry requires mission processing. NG: since May 2025 only electronic visas are used, delivered with a QR code by email. TD: the entry visa must be applied for online at least seven days before travel.
This excludes separate non-tourist visa categories, route-specific limits, health forms, registration and final admission.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: named advance visa routes
policies.summary: The Federal Foreign Office expressly requires pre-departure mission issuance for each listed German ordinary-passport visitor route.
conditions: KP: entry is limited to organized travel with assigned guides or interpreters and Foreign Ministry permission; tourist cases are handled by the travel agency, require a Korean-side invitation, and embassy issuance normally takes at least four weeks. LY: apply at the Libyan Embassy in Berlin for a Germany-based applicant. CG: apply before entry at the Republic of the Congo Embassy in Berlin. SS: apply before entry at the South Sudan Embassy in Berlin. CF: apply before entry at the competent Central African Embassy in Paris. LR: visa-on-arrival issuance has ended; Germany-based travellers apply at the Liberian Embassy in Berlin. ML: apply at a Malian foreign mission in Germany.
This does not normalize travel warnings, operational access, invitations, special documents, work, residence, transit or final admission.

conflicts.explanation: The Federal Foreign Office expressly records airport issuance after a Turkmen Migration Service approval; that is a border-issued visa route under the taxonomy.
The Federal Foreign Office says online application is followed by visa issuance on entry, so it is visa_on_arrival rather than an electronically issued visa.
The Federal Foreign Office requires a Germany-based applicant to apply at the Libyan Embassy in Berlin; it does not establish an electronic route.
The Federal Foreign Office requires German nationals to apply before entry at the South Sudan Embassy in Berlin, not through an e-visa route.
The Federal Foreign Office says the entry visa must be applied for online at least seven days before travel.

No direct Afghan authority source establishes current issuance timing, so fallback visa_required remains a hypothesis.

The current Federal Foreign Office page says only that German nationals need a visa. It does not establish advance, electronic or arrival issuance, and no direct destination-government source was located that resolves that timing. The visa_required fallback is therefore not promoted.
